source.repro: products/jbrowse-web: FIREFOX_NIGHTLY_PATH=... node browser-tests/probe-bar-top-aa.ts --out=<dir>, headed Firefox Nightly 156.0a1 at dpr 2 on a MacBook Pro 16" 2019 (built-in Retina panel), volvox_microarray as an xyplot at ctgA:1-4,000, canvas 2532x180 device px. Four arms: the shader before and after the analytic band, each built with MSAA_SAMPLE_COUNT 4 and 1 in packages/render-core/src/hal/webgpuHal.ts. The constant is flipped locally and put back; nothing in the tree carries a changed value.
source.notes: The sub-pixel top of a bar is recovered per column as (first fully inked device row) minus (the coverage the partial row above it carries), over the 2,208 columns interior to a bar in every arm. The after arms are the reference because they are independently validated: the y domain is [0, 300] over a 90 CSS px row at dpr 2, so a bar top can only sit at 180 - 0.6*score device px and an integer-scored dataset can only put its fractional part on a fifth. The after arms spread across all five residues (179/445/534/491/559); MSAA 4 pushes 1,025 columns into the 0.4 bucket and leaves 20 in 0.6, because four samples can only represent quarters; MSAA 1 collapses 2,151 of 2,208 onto residue 0. One device px is 1.67 score units on this track, so the 1-sample error is 0.46 score units on average and 0.79 at worst.

columns.label: columns with the top on a whole device px
